title: DTC Website Performance and CRO Manager
description:
We are seeking a highly analytical and results-driven Website Performance & CRO Manager to own conversion performance across our Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) client portfolio.



In this role, you will be responsible for improving website conversion rates, optimizing user experience, maintaining website performance standards, and driving measurable revenue growth for Shopify-based brands. You will proactively identify opportunities, develop optimization strategies, execute experiments, and translate data into actionable business decisions.



This is not a task-execution role. We are looking for someone who can independently identify what needs to be optimized, prioritize initiatives based on business impact, and connect every website improvement to measurable performance outcomes.



Key Responsibilities:

- Conduct comprehensive CRO audits to identify user friction, conversion barriers, and revenue opportunities.

- Develop, prioritize, and execute A/B tests across homepages, product detail pages (PDPs), collection pages, landing pages, and checkout experiences.

- Monitor and improve website speed, Core Web Vitals, and overall site performance across all assigned client accounts.

- Own GA4 implementation, tracking accuracy, and reporting across client websites.

- Analyze Shopify and GA4 data to identify opportunities, trends, and performance gaps.

- Manage multiple website optimization initiatives across a portfolio of DTC clients.

- Stay current with CRO, UX, Shopify, analytics, and e-commerce best practices.



Qualifications:

- 3+ years of experience in CRO, website performance, UX optimization, or DTC e-commerce.

- Strong hands-on experience with Shopify, including product pages, themes, site structure, and conversion optimization.

- Advanced proficiency in Google Analytics 4 (GA4).

- Experience using Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, or similar behavioral analytics platforms.

- Demonstrated success running A/B tests and translating results into measurable business outcomes.

- Strong understanding of conversion funnels, user behavior, and customer journey optimization.

- Experience managing multiple client accounts or projects simultaneously.

- Agency experience or experience supporting multiple brands is highly preferred.



What We Offer:

• Competitive salary base

• Permanent remote setup

• Unlimited free access to MAG School courses and SOP Library

• Opportunities for professional development and career advancement



You’re exactly who we’re looking for—so what’s stopping you? Apply now and let’s make it official.

title: DSP Manager
description:
The DSP Manager is responsible for managing and optimizing the demand-side platform to enhance digital advertising performance. This role involves strategic planning, campaign management, and collaboration with internal teams and external partners to drive effective advertising solutions.



Key Responsibilities

• Create SOPs and effectively lead a team to ensure smooth operations and achieve organizational goals

• Oversee the day-to-day operations of the DSP, ensuring optimal performance and efficiency

• Manage the setup, execution, and optimization of advertising campaigns across various channels

• Develop and implement data-driven strategies to maximize campaign performance and ROI

• Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and make real-time adjustments to campaigns as needed

• Analyze campaign data and performance metrics to derive actionable insights and inform future strategies

• Use analytics tools to track audience behavior, conversion rates, and other relevant metrics

• Work closely with cross-functional teams, including sales, creative, and product development, to align campaign objectives and strategies

• Foster relationships with external partners, such as media agencies and ad tech vendors

• Manage campaign budgets effectively, ensuring cost efficiency while meeting performance goals

• Prepare budget forecasts and reports to track spending and ROI

• Stay updated on industry trends, new technologies, and best practices in digital advertising and programmatic buying

• Implement innovative solutions to enhance campaign effectiveness and leverage new opportunities

• Create and present detailed reports on campaign performance to stakeholders, providing insights and recommendations for improvement

title: Ecommerce Escalations & Chargeback Disputes Specialist
description:
Ecommerce Escalations & Chargeback Disputes Specialist (Shopify, Fashion)



We are a growing fashion ecommerce brand selling apparel to customers in the United States and Canada. We are scaling up fast, and we need someone to own the two areas that hurt us most right now: escalated customer cases and chargebacks.



This is NOT a general ticket-answering role. We already have a support team handling standard tickets. We are looking for a specialist who can take full ownership of disputes and who is able to figure out WHY problems happen instead of only responding to them. 



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Own our entire chargeback process end to end: monitor incoming disputes, gather evidence, build and submit representments before the deadline, and track win rates.

- Handle all escalated customer cases: angry customers, complaints, refund and goodwill decisions. You will have the authority to make these decisions yourself within agreed limits.

- Own the returns and refunds experience. Make sure refunds are processed fast, returns are easy to initiate, and customers always know where their return stands. Slow refunds are one of the biggest dispute drivers in apparel.

- Analyse root causes. Tag and categorise tickets, find out what drives our support spikes and our chargebacks, and report on it monthly.

- Track sizing and fit complaints and report them back to us so we can fix product pages and size guides.

- Reduce disputes at the source: proactive delay notifications, clearer delivery expectations, faster refunds, clearer billing descriptors.

- Build the playbooks, macros and SLAs our support team will work from.



WHAT WE REQUIRE



- Hands-on experience fighting chargebacks for an ecommerce store. This is the single most important requirement.

- Experience with Shopify, and with a fashion or apparel brand. You understand sizing complaints, returns, exchanges and wardrobing.

- Experience with a helpdesk tool Re;amaze

- Excellent written English. You will be writing directly to North American customers.

- Strong discipline around deadlines. A missed dispute window is an automatic loss.

- Able to work independently and report proactively. We do not want to chase you for updates.



NICE TO HAVE



- Experience with chargeback automation tools such as Chargeflow or Disputifier.

- Experience with Whop and Shopify Payments.

- Experience at a store that scaled quickly or dealt with unpredictable volume spikes.



WORKING HOURS



At the start the working hours will be part time and eventually when there is more work you can grow out to be fulltime employee. We need someone that is flexibel also in the weekends.



HOW TO APPLY



Please do not send a generic application. Applications missing the items below will be ignored.



1. Describe one chargeback case you personally fought. What was the reason code, what evidence did you submit, and did you win?

2. We receive 20 to 50 chargebacks per month on an apparel store selling to the US and Canada. In your first 30 days, what would you look at first to bring that number down?

3. List the helpdesk and chargeback tools you have used, and for how long.

4. Start your reply with the word DISPUTE so we know you read this.



We reply to every application that follows these steps.

Company: Scaling Edge (AI-powered demand gen agency)?Location: Remote (Philippines) | Hours: UK business hours (Mon–Fri, 9am–6pm London)?Compensation: $5–$7/hour base (DOE) + commission per closed sale



Role Summary

You will run outbound calling to book qualified appointments for our sales team (B2B services). You’ll follow proven scripts, handle objections, qualify prospects, and schedule meetings directly to calendar/CRM. We are ONLY hiring candidates with Perfect English and proven cold calling success.



Key Responsibilities

* Make 80–120 dials/day (predictive or power dialer) to targeted B2B lists.

* Open strong, follow a script, ask qualifying questions, and book/calendar appointments.

* Handle common objections, recover the call, and progress to the next step.

* Log every call with clear notes, call outcomes, and follow-ups in our CRM (GoHighLevel/HubSpot).

* Hit weekly targets: dials, talk time, booked calls, show rate, and qualified opportunities.

* Run rapid A/B tests on openings and rebuttals; report learnings daily.

* Maintain list hygiene; flag bad data and suggest list improvements.

* Attend brief daily huddles; submit end-of-day reports.



Outcomes / KPIs

* Dials: 80–120/day

* Talk Time: 90–150 mins/day

* Booking Rate: 2–5% of answered calls (varies by list)

* Show Rate: 65%+ (with reminders)

* Qualified Meetings: Meets ICP and basic budget/need/timeline criteria

* CRM Hygiene: 100% of calls logged with next action



Must-Have Qualifications

* English: Near-native fluency (C1/C2). Neutral, easy-to-understand accent. Excellent grammar and idiomatic usage.

* Experience: 1–3+ years in cold calling/tele-sales/appointment setting (B2B preferred).

* Proof of performance: Past KPIs (dials/day, bookings/week, show/close rates) and call recordings.

* Objection handling: Confident, concise, and coachable.

* Tech: Reliable laptop, wired internet (?25 Mbps down / 10 Mbps up), quiet workspace, noise-cancelling headset.

* Tools: Comfortable with dialers (Aircall, RingCentral, GO HighLevel), Google Workspace, Slack.

* Availability: Can work UK daytime hours consistently; minimal schedule conflicts.



Strong Pluses

* Lived/studied in an English-speaking country or attended English-medium schools.

* B2B agency, SaaS, consulting, or high-ticket service experience.

* Calendar booking + CRM automation (GoHighLevel) familiarity.

* Copy/DM outreach skills to complement calling.



Compensation & Growth

* Base: $5–$7/hour depending on experience and voice quality.

* Commission: Per closed sale (uncapped).

* Performance bonuses: Monthly bonuses for exceeding KPIs.

* Advancement: Senior Caller, Team Lead, QA/Trainer for top performers.



Training & Support

* 3 days paid onboarding: product, ICP, scripts, objections, CRM.

* Live call coaching, recorded call reviews, and weekly optimization.

title: Expert Media Buyer (Facebook Ads & Google)
description:
Scaling Edge is an AI-first business development agency based in London, working with coaches, consultants, finance brands, property firms, and professional service businesses. We build paid acquisition systems, AI lead generation infrastructure, and automation workflows that drive measurable revenue for our clients. We've generated over £3M in client sales through our paid and organic systems, and we're scaling fast.



We're looking for a senior media buyer who can take ownership of client ad accounts, launch and optimise campaigns end-to-end, and operate as a client-facing strategist.



The Role



This is a hands-on, client-facing position. You'll own the day-to-day execution of paid media for a portfolio of clients: building campaigns inside Meta Ads Manager, uploading creatives, customising prebuilt funnels and workflows in GoHighLevel, writing copy, briefing creative, optimising performance, and reporting directly to clients.



You will NOT be building funnels or automations from scratch. Our workflows, funnel templates, and automations are already built; your job is to plug clients in, tweak, customise, and optimise.



We use AI heavily across our workflows (Claude, ChatGPT, Midjourney, image and video generation tools), so you need to be fluent in leveraging AI to move faster without sacrificing output quality.



What You'll Be Doing



Media Buying & Account Management



Build campaigns from scratch inside Meta Ads Manager (campaign structure, ad sets, audiences, placements)

Upload ad creatives, write and test copy variations, manage budgets

Run structured 3 to 5 day testing protocols and scale winners

Daily account monitoring, audience research, and optimisation decisions

Focus on CPL, CAC, and ROAS across multiple client verticals (finance, property, coaching, professional services)

Funnel & Workflow Customisation (Prebuilt in GoHighLevel)



Customise and tweak our prebuilt call funnels, webinar funnels, landing pages, and
/SMS/WhatsApp sequences inside GHL

Adjust copy, branding, and offers per client

Make sure pixels, tracking, and CRM integrations are firing correctly

Ad Copy & Creative Direction



Write direct-response ad copy across hooks, body, and CTAs

Use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) to accelerate copywriting, ideation, and angle testing

Write video ad scripts (UGC, talking head, VSL, story-led)

Brief image ad designers with clear visual direction and assess output against best practice

Review and critique video ads against retention, hook strength, pacing, and conversion criteria

Client Communication & Reporting



Run client calls (kickoffs, weekly check-ins, performance reviews)

Send out clear, well-written weekly performance reports

Stay active and responsive on WhatsApp and Slack throughout the working day

Translate ad data into clear business language for non-technical founders

Manage expectations, set realistic KPIs, and own the relationship

What You Need to Have



3+ years managing Meta Ads accounts with meaningful budgets

GoHighLevel experience is mandatory, not negotiable

Perfect written and spoken English, you'll be client-facing daily

Strong copywriting chops, you can write a hook, a VSL, and a follow-up sequence without hand-holding

Comfortable using AI tools daily for copy, ideation, and creative briefs

Strong creative eye, you can look at an image ad or video ad and know what's wrong with it

Experience scripting video ads (UGC, talking head, story-driven)

Confident on client calls, you can present numbers, push back when needed, and hold the room

Active and responsive communicator on Slack and WhatsApp during working hours

Self-managed, organised, and proactive (we don't micromanage)

Nice to Have



Experience in finance, property, or high-ticket coaching verticals

LinkedIn Ads or Google Ads experience

ClickUp or Notion-based agency workflow experience

How to Apply



When applying, please include:



A short note on the highest-performing campaign you've personally run (numbers, vertical, what made it work)

Confirmation of your GoHighLevel experience and the types of funnels you've worked inside

Your availability, timezone, and preferred working hours

We move fast and make decisions quickly. If you're a strong fit, expect to hear back within 48 hours.

We run a podcast production agency for businesses and creators, and we need more Content Producers on our roster on projects as they come, paid per project.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- When there's no brand kit, pull the brand direction out of past episodes yourself



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Tight writer with editorial taste

- Can make a call when the brief is messy and the client is a real human with opinions

- Work with minimal hand holding

- English fluency



Remote, project-based, small teams. We've spent a lot of time building the operational layer around this role - templates, brief format, feedback loop - so you're not stuck doing PM work. You should be spending your time on the editorial calls.



This starts per project with steady volume for the right person, and it can grow into more consistent work over time. The first step after we review portfolios is a short paid test edit.



If you're good at this, apply.

title: Quantity Surveryor
description:
The Quantity Surveyor supports the profitable growth of product sales as a member of the Engineering Services team. This role is responsible for providing bill of materials development, product take-offs, and project support for B-Line products, including cable tray, bolted framing, and seismic systems.



The position collaborates closely with internal and external stakeholders to support bid preparation, proposal development, project documentation, product presentations, and technical project activities. The Quantity Surveyor also assists in delivering cost-effective solutions, maintaining accurate project documentation, and supporting issue resolution to help ensure successful project execution and customer satisfaction.



 



- Support B-Line MEPF structural support products by coordinating technical and project-related activities throughout the project lifecycle.

- Prepare accurate bill of materials, material take-offs, and product quantity estimates for cable tray, bolted framing, seismic, and related product systems.

- Collaborate with engineering, marketing, manufacturing, and other cross-functional teams to ensure the timely and accurate delivery of project requirements and material take-offs.

- Perform project support activities, including material and engineering service take-offs, quotation support, scope document preparation, drawing layouts, submittal development, release schedules, and post-order documentation.

- Partner with customers and sales teams to develop cost-effective solutions that meet project requirements and business objectives.

- Support the preparation and management of proposals, bid documents, project documentation, and other engineering-related deliverables.

- Maintain accurate project records and documentation in accordance with company processes and quality standards.

- Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.





Qualifications:



- Degree in Quantity Surveying, Engineering, Building, Construction Management, or a related field.

- Minimum of two (2) years of experience in electrical and/or mechanical product estimation, quantity surveying, construction, engineering support, or a related discipline.

- Knowledge of MEPF systems and non-structural component supports, including seismic bracing applications.

- Experience supporting projects within the Oil & Gas, Power, Mining, Data Center, heavy industrial, or similar sectors.

- Familiarity with applicable industry codes and standards, including NEC, IEC, NEMA, ASME, CSA, NFPA, IBC, CBC, UL, FM, and other relevant standards.

- Knowledge of manufacturing and project documentation requirements, including submittal drawings, production drawings, test reports, and certifications.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, AutoCAD, Bluebeam, and other relevant estimation, design, and documentation tools.

- Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and accuracy.

- Understanding of construction methodologies, engineering drawings, and project execution processes.

- Effective verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate and build positive working relationships across diverse teams and stakeholders.

- Ability to learn new concepts, systems, and technologies and apply them in a practical business environment.

- Demonstrated sound judgment and the ability to identify and recommend effective solutions to project challenges.

- Ability to work independently and collaboratively, depending on project and team requirements.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work within established timelines.

- Strong organizational and time management skills with a commitment to continuous improvement and customer service.

- Demonstrated commitment to teamwork, inclusion, and fostering a respectful and collaborative work environment.

title: Customer Service & Inbound Sales Coordinator
description:
Customer Service & Inbound Sales Coordinator | Chat-based



Full-Time Remote Position | Singapore Company

PHP 28,000 during probation | PHP 33,000 after confirmation | Potential to earn PHP 38,000 to PHP 46,000 or more per month when commission is unlocked



At BirthdayMagicShow.sg & FamilyFunMagicShow.sg, we are one of Singapore’s leading party and event entertainment companies, specialising in highly interactive magic shows for children and adults, young and old.



We create unforgettable magical experiences at birthday parties and family events across Singapore, and we are looking for a warm, dependable, and highly self-directed Customer Service & Sales Coordinator to be the first point of contact for our clients.



-------------------------------



This role is ideal for someone who:

• Learns independently and takes ownership of their progress

• Follows established systems and communication templates carefully

• Communicates promptly, warmly, clearly and professionally

• Takes initiative without needing constant supervision



This is primarily a written customer-service and sales role, with most customer conversations taking place through WhatsApp.



You will receive clear systems, communication templates, real conversation examples, and guidance to help you succeed. You should also be comfortable learning independently, applying feedback, and taking ownership of your progress.



==========================

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

==========================

• PHP 28,000 monthly salary during the three-month probation period

• PHP 33,000 monthly salary after successfully completing probation

• Opportunity to unlock uncapped sales commission by demonstrating the ability to manage enquiries and close sales independently, together with strong proficiency in our systems, processes and communication templates

- Once unlocked, you’ll earn commission for every booking you close, with higher commission when monthly sales increase.

- With strong sales performance, total monthly earnings can reach PHP 38,000 to 46,000 or more, with no fixed maximum

• 14 days of paid Annual Leave after probation

• 14 days of paid Medical Leave after probation

• Philippines Public Holidays observed



==========================

WORK SCHEDULE

==========================

Working days: Monday, Tuesday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday

Rest days: Wednesday and Thursday

Working hours: 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, including a one hour meal break

Total working hours: 40 hours per week

Work arrangement: 100% remote / work from home



Please note that Saturdays and Sundays are important working days for this position.



==========================

WHAT YOU WILL DO

==========================

• Respond to customer enquiries through WhatsApp promptly, warmly, and professionally

• Understand each customer’s needs and recommend the most suitable services and packages

• Use our approved communication templates while adapting them appropriately to each conversation

• Keep conversations moving towards a confirmed booking without sounding pushy

• Coordinate schedules, payments, and booking details between customers and our performers

• Follow up on enquiries, payments, and post-event reviews consistently

• Help every customer feel heard, cared for, and confident about booking us



==========================

REQUIREMENTS

==========================

• Excellent written and spoken English, with strong reading comprehension

• Comfortable communicating with customers and closing sales

• Proficient in Google Drive, Google Sheets, Google Docs, Google Calendar, WhatsApp, and ChatGPT

• Stable internet connection and a quiet, suitable work-from-home environment

• A two-monitor workstation setup or willingness to arrange one before starting

• Available to work the stated schedule, including Saturdays and Sundays



Previous experience in customer service, sales, administration, or remote work is an advantage.



Your ability to learn quickly, follow systems, communicate well, and take ownership matters more to us.



==========================

WHY JOIN US?

==========================

• Stable, full-time remote position with a supportive and family-oriented team

• Clear systems, training materials, guidance, and feedback to help you succeed

• Opportunity to develop valuable customer service, sales, and operational skills

• Salary increase after probation and the opportunity to unlock uncapped commission

• Room to grow and contribute to our mission of spreading joy ?



We are a lean and close-knit company. Every tea
mber plays an important role, and we genuinely care about the quality of the experiences we create.



==========================

HOW TO APPLY

==========================

We review every application carefully.



To be considered, please submit all of the following:



1. YOUR RESUME OR CV

Highlight any relevant experience in customer service, sales, administration, or remote work.



2. A 1 to 2 MINUTE INTRODUCTION VIDEO

Introduce yourself and share with us:

• Why you are interested in this position

• Why you believe you would be a good fit

• How you normally learn a new system or process independently



Please be yourself. We are more interested in getting to know you.



3. CUSTOMER MESSAGE EXERCISE

Imagine that a parent sends this message through WhatsApp:



 “Hi, I’m planning my daughter’s seventh birthday party next month. Can you send me your prices?”



Write the WhatsApp response you would send as our Customer Service & Sales Coordinator.



4. WORKSTATION INFORMATION

Please share with us:

• Are you using a Windows computer or a Mac?

• How many monitors are you currently using, and what are their sizes?

• This role is best performed with two monitors, as you will regularly work across customer conversations, communication templates, calendars, and booking records. If you currently have only one monitor, would you be willing to acquire a second one before starting?



5. IMPORTANT APPLICATION INSTRUCTION

Begin your application with the exact words: “I have read the complete job description.”

This instruction helps us identify candidates who read and follow application requirements carefully.



• Only complete applications that follow the instructions will be considered

• Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted

• Application deadline: 11 August 2026



==========================

ABOUT US

==========================

BirthdayMagicShow.sg and FamilyFunMagicShow.sg provide highly interactive magic shows and family entertainment for events across Singapore. Our team of magicians, games hosts, balloon artists, caricaturists, face painters, hand painters, and other entertainment professionals works together to create joyful experiences and lasting memories for children, families, and corporate clients.



Thank you for your time, and we look forward to receiving your application!

title: Amazon PPC Assistant
description:
About the Company

AMS Management LLC is a boutique e-commerce advertising agency managing paid media, catalogue, and growth services for brands selling on Amazon, Walmart, and Chewy. We are a fully remote, distributed team working across time zones, 



Role Purpose

The PPC Assistant supports the Account Manager and PPC Manager/Lead in the day-to-day PPC execution, monitoring, and reporting of client advertising accounts across Amazon, Walmart, and Chewy. This is an experienced execution role, mid-level position. We are looking for someone with 3 to 5 years of hands-on marketplace advertising experience who can work accurately at pace, follow established SOPs, flag issues before they become problems, and free the Account Managers to focus on strategy and client communication.



Key Responsibilities

Campaign execution and maintenance

Build and launch campaigns according to the brief across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display

Implement bid adjustments, budget changes, and keyword actions as directed by the Account Manager

Carry out routine search term reviews, negative keyword harvesting, and keyword migration

Maintain accurate campaign naming conventions and account structures per agency standards



Monitoring and pacing

Run daily budget pacing checks across assigned accounts and flag/adjust for overspend or underspend risks

Monitor account health, disapproved ads, and out-of-budget campaigns and escalate promptly

Track performance against ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, CTR, and CVR targets and highlight anomalies

Flag ASINs with declining conversion or traffic trends

Flag pricing changes affecting conversion and suppressed listings causing ads not to deliver



Reporting and administration

Prepare weekly performance snapshots and monthly reporting inputs for the Account Manager to review

Keep client dashboards, trackers, and data pulls accurate and up to date

Document work in the WOS with clear status updates and turnaround estimates

Track time to complete tasks with the WOS

Maintain organised account documentation and change logs in the WOS

Investigate major week-on-week performance changes

Highlight opportunities, risks and recommended actions



Team collaboration

Work closely with the Account Manager, project manager, catalogue team, and graphic designer to align advertising with listing content and imagery

Follow agency SOPs and contribute improvements where processes can be tightened

Communicate proactively and asynchronously across time zones



Requirements

3 to 5 years of hands-on PPC experience, with meaningful time spent inside Amazon Ads consoles

Solid working knowledge of Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display campaign types

Fluent understanding of core marketplace metrics including ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, CTR, CVR, and impression share, and what movements in each actually mean

Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills for bulk file work, data pulls, and reporting

High attention to detail and accuracy when making changes in live client accounts

Fluent written English and reliable, responsive async communication

Reliable remote setup and availability with meaningful overlap with US working hours

Comfortable taking direction, following SOPs, and asking questions early rather than guessing

Ability to prioritise multiple deadlines 



Nice to have

Experience with Walmart Connect or Chewy Ads, or proven ability to master new ad platforms quickly

Experience with Scale Insights or similar PPC automation and analytics tools

Agency experience managing multiple client accounts in parallel

Exposure to DSP campaigns

Experience with bulk operations files and large-scale campaign restructures

Familiarity with ClickUp



Success Measures

Accuracy in live account changes such as wrong bids, budgets, or targeting

Pacing: daily budget checks completed on schedule with issues flagged same day

Reporting: weekly snapshots delivered on time and requiring minimal rework

Independence: routine optimisation tasks executed to brief without repeated correction.

Ability to manage multiple client accounts independently after onboarding 



What We Offer

Fully remote, full-time independent contractor engagement

Semi-flexible work hours

Paid Time off

title: Accountant
description:
We are an Australian financial advisory company seeking a highly capable Offshore Accountant to support our accounting operations. We are looking for someone with solid Australian company experience, strong attention to detail, and advanced hands-on experience using Xero platform. 



This role is ideal for an accountant who is confident working independently, understand Australian business and tax processes, and can deliver accurate, timely, and insightful financial support. 



Key Responsibilities: 

- Structure, manage, and track client or business rebates. 

- Process employee payments, including monthly and fortnightly payroll support. 

- Manage cash flow monitoring and reporting. 

- Perform bank reconciliations and general account reconciliation. 

- Support and coordinate audit requirements and documentation. 

- Manage Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable processes. 

- Assist with budgeting and forecasting activities. 

- Prepare management reports and provide financial insights. 

- Liaise with internal stakeholders and external parties on tax-related matters. 

- Maintain accurate financial records and ensure timely processing of transactions. 

- Identify process improvements to enhance finance efficiency and accuracy. 



Required Experience and Skills: 

- Proven experience working with Australian companies or within an Australian accounting/finance environment. 

- Strong practical experience using Xero, including reconciliations, AP/AR, reporting, and general ledger management. 

- Experience in payroll processing, including monthly and fortnightly payment cycles. 

- Solid understanding of core accounting processes, including reconciliations, cash flow, payables, and receivables. 

- Experience supporting audits and preparing finance-related documentation. 

- Good understanding of Australian business and finance practices. 

- Strong analytical skills and attention to detail. 

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. 

- Ability to work remotely, manage deadlines, and maintain confidentiality. 



Preferred Qualifications: 

- Experience in a professional services, financial advisory, accounting, or similar Australian business environment. 

- Exposure to Australian tax or compliance-related processes. 

- Accounting qualification, bookkeeping certification, or equivalent relevant experience. 

- Ability to provide financial insights beyond transactional processing. 



What We Are Looking For: 

- Reliable, proactive, and organised. 

- Comfortable working with an Australian team and Australian business standards. 

- Able to take ownership of finance tasks with minimal supervision. 

- Process-driven, accurate, and committed to meeting deadlines.

title: Creator Sourcing & Influencer Outreach Specialist
description:
Creator Sourcing & Influencer Outreach Specialist



Full Time - Must map to US working hours. 



About Ingreendients



Ingreendients is a plant-based personal care brand focused on high-performing hair care and body care products made with transparent, plant-derived ingredients.



We are building a creator-led marketing program across Instagram and TikTok and are looking for a highly organized, persistent, and resourceful person to help us identify creators, manage outreach, coordinate product seeding, and build a consistent pipeline of authentic video content.



This is not a general social media posting role.



Your primary responsibility will be to help us find the right creators and turn those relationships into high-quality videos that can be tested through paid advertising.



The Role



You will spend a significant portion of each day researching creators on Instagram and TikTok who are a strong fit for our brand.



You will then organize them, evaluate their content, reach out to them, follow up, coordinate product shipments, track communication, and help move each creator from initial discovery through completed content and advertising permissions.



Our goal is to build a large and continuously growing library of authentic creator videos that can be tested across Meta, Instagram, TikTok, Amazon, and other marketing channels.



Primary Responsibilities



Creator Research and Sourcing



* Research Instagram and TikTok creators every day

* Identify creators in clean beauty, hair care, wellness, non-toxic living, fitness, motherhood, lifestyle, and related niches

* Find micro-creators, small and mid sized creators

* Review creator content for authenticity, communication style, video quality, audience alignment, and advertising potential

* Identify creators who are comfortable speaking on camera and demonstrating products

* Build and maintain a large, organized creator database

* Avoid duplicate outreach and keep creator records accurate



Creator Evaluation



For each creator, evaluate and record:



* Name

* Instagram and TikTok handles

* Platform links

* Follower count

* Estimated engagement

* Primary niche

* Audience profile

* Location

* Content style

* Video quality

* On-camera communication

* Brand fit

* Past beauty or wellness collaborations

* Contact information

* Why the creator may be a strong fit

* Potential content angle

* Outreach status



Outreach and Follow-Up



* Send personalized outreach messages by
, Instagram, and TikTok

* Avoid generic mass outreach

* Explain why each creator is relevant to the brand

* Follow up consistently and professionally

* Respond to creator questions

* Track negotiations and creator expectations

* Schedule calls when necessary

* Maintain accurate records of every interaction



Product Seeding and Content Coordination



* Collect shipping details

* Coordinate product shipments with the operations team

* Track delivery

* Follow up after product delivery

* Confirm which products and content concepts the creator will test

* Help prepare creative briefs and talking points

* Track expected delivery dates for content

* Follow up until content is received

* Organize completed videos and raw files



Whitelisting and Advertising Permissions



* Ask creators for permission to use their content in paid advertising

* Help coordinate Meta Partnership Ads, Instagram permissions, TikTok Spark Ads, and other whitelisting processes

* Maintain records of usage rights and agreed terms

* Confirm whether content can be edited, resized, and used across multiple channels

* Coordinate with the Founder and marketing team when content is ready for testing



Reporting and Organization



* Maintain a clean creator pipeline in Google Sheets, Airtable, Notion, or another approved system

* Provide daily and weekly progress updates

* Report outreach volume, replies, interested creators, products shipped, content received, and permissions secured

* Identify bottlenecks and recommend process improvements

* Create and improve SOPs for creator sourcing, outreach, follow-up, and content tracking



What Success Looks Like



The successful person in this role will consistently:



* Find high-quality, relevant creators

* Send thoughtful and personalized outreach

* Follow up without needing reminders

* Keep the creator pipeline extremely organized

* Move creators from initial contact to completed content

* Build strong and respectful creator relationships

* Help us create a growing library of authentic videos

* Improve the process over time using AI, templates, and systems



Initial Performance Expectations



During the first 30–60 days, we expect you to build a repeatable creator sourcing and outreach system.



Potential activity targets may include:



* Researching and evaluating 30–50 relevant creators per day

* Sending 15–30 personalized outreach messages per day

* Completing consistent follow-ups

* Maintaining accurate pipeline records

* Securing a growing number of interested creators each week

* Helping move creators toward product trials, completed videos, and paid advertising permissions



Quality is more important than sending large volumes of generic messages.



Required Qualifications



* Excellent written and spoken English

* Strong internet research skills

* Highly organized and detail-oriented

* Comfortable spending several hours each day researching creators

* Strong follow-up discipline

* Professional and friendly communication

* Comfortable using Instagram and TikTok

* Strong Google Sheets skills

* Comfortable learning new software and systems

* Ability to work independently and manage repetitive workflows accurately

* Willingness to work U.S. business hours

* Reliable internet and computer



referred Experience



Experience in one or more of the following is helpful:



* Influencer marketing

* Creator sourcing

* Influencer outreach

* Affiliate marketing

* Social media research

* UGC coordination

* Beauty, wellness, hair care, or consumer products

* Meta Partnership Ads

* Instagram whitelisting

* TikTok Spark Ads

* Creator databases or CRM systems



Prior experience is helpful, but intelligence, persistence, organization, communication, and willingness to learn are equally important.



## AI and Workflow Expectations



You should be comfortable using tools such as ChatGPT or Claude to:



* Research creators

* Improve outreach messages

* Personalize communication

* Summarize creator profiles

* Generate content-angle ideas

* Organize information

* Improve follow-up systems

* Create SOPs and workflow efficiencies



AI should improve the quality and speed of your work, not produce generic or impersonal outreach.



## Who You Are



You may be a strong fit if:



* You enjoy research and finding people online

* You are naturally persistent

* You do not give up after one unanswered message

* You are highly organized

* You enjoy communicating with creators

* You notice quality and authenticity in videos

* You can follow a detailed process consistently

* You take ownership without waiting for constant instructions

* You are interested in building something long-term



## To Apply



Please submit the following:



1. Your resume

2. A short introduction explaining why this role interests you

3. Any relevant influencer, outreach, research, social media, or creator-management experience





Please also complete the short application exercise below.



Application Exercise



Part 1 — Creator Research



Find 10 Instagram or TikTok creators who you believe would be a strong fit for Ingreendients.



Please include:



* Creator name

* Instagram or TikTok handle

* Platform link

* Follower count

* Content niche

* Why you selected them

* One content angle you believe they could create for the brand

* Whether you believe they would be a strong candidate for paid advertising and why



Please DO NOT select celebrities or very large creators. Focus will be on micro, small and mid-size creators.



Part 2 — Outreach



Write one personalized outreach message to one of the creators you selected.



The message should:



* Reference something specific about the creator

* Explain why the creator fits the brand

* Invite them to try the products

* Sound warm and human

* Avoid sounding like a mass template



Part 3 — Organization



Create a simple spreadsheet showing how you would track:



* Creator researched

* Outreach sent

* Follow-up dates

* Response

* Shipping status

* Content due date

* Content received

* Advertising permission

* Final status



Please submit the spreadsheet as a Google Sheets link or Excel file.



Part 4 — Short Written Response



Please answer:



* How would you decide whether a creator's video is suitable for paid advertising?

* What would you do if a creator did not respond after the first message?

* How would you manage 200–300 creators without losing track of conversations?

* What AI tools would you use in this role, and how?



Applications that do not include the exercise may not be considered.

title: Outbound Appointment Setter
description:
About Tradezi:

Tradezi is a done-for-you digital business platform built exclusively for UK tradespeople — plumbers, electricians,

painters and decorators, solar installers, and similar trades. We give small and medium-sized trade businesses

everything they need to win more work and run more efficiently in one monthly subscription, including:

• A professional website with an online presence built for their trade

• Lead generation through paid advertising (Google Ads, social media advertising, etc.)

• An online booking system so customers can book jobs directly and tradespeople stay organised

• An AI call-answering service that picks up calls tradespeople miss while out on the tools

• Local search engine optimisation (SEO) to help clients rank at the top of Google in their area



We are currently focused on the SME segment of the UK trades industry. Tradezi is led by joint Managing Directors

Mike Connolly (Sales) and Cherelle (Marketing), and sits within a wider group that shares lead generation, web

production, and telephony capability across four trading companies.



The Role:

We're hiring an Outbound Appointment Setter to generate qualified appointments for Mike and Cherelle to close with UK

trade business owners. You'll be the first point of contact for prospective clients, responsible for opening

conversations, qualifying interest, and booking them in for a demo/consultation call. This is a high-activity, target-

driven outbound role ideal for someone with a marketing or sales background who enjoys the phone and is motivated

by commission.



Key Responsibilities:

• Make outbound calls to UK trade businesses (plumbers, electricians, painters & decorators, solar installers, and

similar) using the company's mobile dialling application

• Follow call scripts and objection-handling frameworks to engage business owners and generate interest in

Tradezi's services

• Qualify prospects against our target SME criteria before booking

• Book qualified appointments directly into Mike and Cherelle's diaries for demo/sales calls

• Maintain accurate, up-to-date records of calls, contacts, and appointment outcomes in the CRM

• Consistently hit daily and monthly activity and booking targets

• Follow up on warm leads and previously contacted prospects to convert them into booked appointments

• Work UK dialling hours (08:30–17:00 UK time) to reach prospects when their businesses are open

• Feed back on call outcomes, objections, and prospect trends to help refine scripts and targeting



Objectives:

• 3 appointments per day minimum

• 150+ outbound calls per day



Candidate Requirements:

• Previous experience in an outbound sales, telemarketing, appointment setting, or marketing role — B2B

experience preferred

• Excellent spoken English with a clear, confident, and professional phone manner

• Comfortable working to daily call volume and appointment-booking targets

• Resilient and self-motivated — able to handle rejection and stay consistent across high call volumes

• Strong organisational skills and comfortable using CRM/diary booking systems

• Reliable internet connection and a quiet home working environment suitable for a full-time remote calling role

• Available to work UK business hours (08:30–17:00 UK time), Monday to Thursday & 08:30–15:00 UK time on Fridays

• Understanding of, or willingness to quickly learn, the UK trades industry is an advantage but not essential



Remuneration Package:

This role offers a competitive basic hourly rate plus uncapped commission on every sale generated from your booked

appointments, along with monthly volume bonuses. All figures are paid in USD.



Basic:

• $6.00 USD per hour, full-time, Monday to Friday



Commission:

Commission is earned on every sale that converts from an appointment you have booked, based on the package the

client signs up to:



Foundation Package Sale - $25

Growth Package Sale - $50

Pro Package Sale - $75



Commission Uplift: 

10 deals in a calendar month - $100 (additional bonus)

20 deals in a calendar month - $250 (additional bonus)

30 deals in a calendar month - $500 (additional bonus)

The Amazon SEO Manager owns the organic discoverability and conversion performance of our Amazon catalog by building and executing a disciplined SEO system. This role ensures our listings are consistently optimized with the right keywords, content, and structure, so we rank higher, earn more organic traffic, and convert more shoppers - reducing reliance on paid ads over time.

SQP/SI review weekly/as needed; identify actions and implement

Weekly SEO/Optimization sync (priority list + actions + blockers)

Weekly PPC alignment (keyword harvesting + targeting coordination)

Weekly creative coordination (assets needed, deadlines, tests)



Key Skills

Amazon SEO strategy + execution (keyword research, indexing, rank growth)

Strong copy + conversion thinking (CTR/CVR-focused content decisions)

Data literacy (SQP/SI/keyword tools) and action orientation

Organized project management across many ASINs

Experience with Amazon reporting and insight tools (SQP/Scale Insights or equivalents)

title: Full-Time AI Video Editor, US DTC Brand at $500K/Month
description:
We need an AI killer who can also actually edit. Not an editor who uses AI sometimes.



ABOUT US



US DTC brand in the women's health and intimates space, currently doing $500K per month and scaling hard on Meta. Almost all of our spend runs on
, which means creative is the entire growth lever. The person who makes our creative is the most important hire we make this quarter.



THE TEAM



You work alongside our creative strategist and our other editors. Briefs come from the strategist, and we want your input on angles and concepts.



We train you on our brand, our angles and what has already won for us, so you are not guessing. As we scale there is room to take on more ownership over the creative output.



THE ROLE



Full-time, fully remote, immediate start. You generate winning AI ad creative at volume alongside our creative team.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- VSLs. This is the core of the role. Long and short form, built on problem, agitation, solution, proof, offer, CTA. You hold retention across a long runtime with pacing, pattern interrupts, captions and sound, all synced tight to the voiceover.



- AI b-roll for VSLs that looks like real footage. The hardest and most important part of this job. Every VSL needs constant visual support, and most of it does not exist as real footage. You generate it and it has to read as genuinely filmed. Real people, real rooms, real hands, real lighting. If it looks generated, it kills the VSL. You know which model to reach for, you know the tells that give AI away, and you rebuild until it passes as real.



- AI UGC that does not look like AI. Creator-style talking head footage and podcast-style clips that read as real people on a real phone. Native to the
 feed, not obviously synthetic. If a viewer clocks it as AI in the first second, it failed.



- AI animation across styles. Pixar-style, 3D, claymation, motion. Not decoration. The animation has to actually explain the product mechanism and stay congruent with the script beat for beat.



- AI song ads. Full concept to finished asset.



- Voiceover that holds up. Natural pacing, correct emphasis, no robotic tells, consistent across every asset you ship.



- Editing that carries the ad. Generation is half the job. The other half is the cut. Hooks in the first three seconds, ruthless pacing, pattern interrupts, captions, sound design, and knowing exactly where a viewer drops off and why.



- Direct response thinking. You can tell selling creative from pretty creative. You think from the customer's perspective, not the editor's, and you pitch new angles when you see them.



- Volume. 10 to 15 concepts per week depending on length, assigned with the creative team. Fast turnaround, no shortcuts on quality.



YOU'RE A GREAT FIT IF



- 2 to 5+ years editing for DTC ecommerce brands. This is not an entry-level role and it is not for editors coming from wedding films or YouTube

- You have real VSL experience and can show it

- You can generate AI b-roll that passes as real footage, not stylised or obviously synthetic

- Your primary craft is AI generation, and your editing is genuinely strong on top of it

- Your portfolio shows consistent AI output, not two or three lucky samples

- You know which model to reach for and why, and you rebuild fast when a generation misses

- You are strong on captions, typography, sound design, overlays and voiceover pacing

- You understand direct response and what makes people stop scrolling

- You learn new tools within days of them launching



TOOLS



Higgsfield, Veo, Kling, Sora, Seedance, Nano Banana, Midjourney, ElevenLabs, Runway, HeyGen, After Effects, Premiere or DaVinci or CapCut, Meta Ad Library. You do not need every one of these, but you should already live in several of them.



WHAT WE OFFER



- Competitive full-time salary, custom offer built around your skill and portfolio

- Performance bonuses on top, tied to creative that wins and scales. This is not a token bonus, it is how our best people earn

- Fully remote, full-time, long-term

- Room to grow with the brand as we scale



Full-time only. We are not considering freelance or part-time.



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in our Google form: 



If you make ads that perform instead of ads that look nice, we want to talk.

title: Email & Static Ad Designer (Part-Time) - Figma Design for DTC Marketing Agency
description:
About Us



We are BeMarketing, a Danish performance marketing agency serving a portfolio of e-commerce (DTC) brands. We run paid ads, Google Ads, and
 marketing for our clients. We are building out a dedicated design function to own all
 design and static ad creative. This is a long-term role for the right person, not a one-off gig.



The Role



You will own all graphic design across two lanes:
 design (Klaviyo
s for our client brands) and static ad design (Meta ads). You design - you do NOT build in Klaviyo. A dedicated Klaviyo technician takes your finished Figma files and builds them. Your job is to make them great.



You work asynchronously most of the week. We communicate on Slack, and all work is tracked in Notion. Every design you make follows a clear, documented brief with finished copy - you are never guessing what to write or what the offer is. You are never guessing what to do. On top of that, we have one weekly video call together - to review work, plan the week ahead, and build a real working relationship. You are part of the team, not an anonymous freelancer.



This is a volume role with high standards. Expect roughly 30-60
s per month across multiple client brands (campaign
s + flow
s), plus ongoing static ad production. Deadlines are real and non-negotiable.



This is a growth role, and we are hiring a key player - not a disposable VA. Phase 1 is design execution:
s and static ads from briefs, delivered on time, at high quality. As you prove yourself, there is a clear path to real ownership: client design systems,
 template libraries, and creative direction on the static ad side.



Compensation is a fixed monthly salary ($750-1,500/month depending on experience) - stable, predictable income, not per-asset piecework. 13th month pay included.



What You'll Do



 design (the core of the role):



- Design campaign
s and flow
s in Figma from documented briefs (copy, offer, and structure provided - you own layout, hierarchy, and visual execution)

- Design mobile-first: most of our audience reads
 on a phone

- Work strictly within each client's brand guidelines (colors, fonts, logo rules, tone) - and never mix brands up

- Structure your Figma files so they are slice-ready for our Klaviyo technician (clean sections, consistent widths, organized layers)

- Revise quickly based on feedback from the founder or the client



Static ad design:



- Design static ads for Meta (feed + story formats) from creative briefs

- Work both ways: classic manual design (Figma/Photoshop) AND AI image tools (Nano banana, Google's image models, or similar) with professional retouching on top

- Produce variations of winning ads fast (new hooks, new formats, new aspect ratios)



Quality & delivery:



- Self-QA every file before handoff: correct brand assets, aligned grids, readable at mobile size, no typos in design text, exportable structure

- Hit deadlines every time - and flag problems early, not on the day they are due

- Update status and notes in Notion, communicate clearly on Slack



What We're Looking For (Must-Haves)



- A DTC / e-commerce portfolio - you have designed real
s AND real ads for e-commerce brands. We want to see the actual work.

- Conversion-first design instinct - you understand visual hierarchy, CTA placement, and offer communication. Pretty is not enough; your designs need to sell.

- Brand-system discipline - you can work across multiple client brands in the same week and keep every one of them consistent with its own guidelines.

- Strong Figma skills - components, auto layout, organized files ready for handoff

- Comfortable with AI image tools as part of your workflow (and honest about how you use them)

- Strong written English - clear async communication on Slack

- Reliable and self-managing - you hit deadlines and flag problems early

- Comfortable with Notion and Slack workflows

- Wants to be part of a team long-term - you show up to a weekly call, take ownership, and care about the results of your work (not just the delivery)



Nice to Have



- Photoshop / retouching skills

- Familiarity with Klaviyo or
 design constraints (max widths, image slicing, dark mode)

- Motion design / simple GIFs for
 or ads

- Experience working with an agency or across multiple client accounts



How to Apply



- To show us you actually read this posting, start your application with the word "PIXEL".

Applications that don't include it will be ignored.



Then, please include:



1. Your portfolio - share
 designs AND static ads you have made for e-commerce brands (links or attachments). We want to see the actual work, not a mood board.



2. Answer these three questions:

- How do you keep two different client brands visually separate when you design for both in the same week?

- Which AI image tools do you use, and where in your process do you use them?

- How many hours per week are you available, and what are your working hours (please note your timezone)?



3. A short note on why a long-term agency role - where you grow into owning the design function - appeals to you more than one-off freelance gigs.



We review every application that includes the filter word. Response time is typically within a few business days.

title: Senior Python Engineer — Camera Fleet Platform (Full-time, Long-term)
description:
About us



We build and operate CCTV for construction sites across Australia. We build the hardware and we build the software that runs it — live view, playback, alarm monitoring, onboarding, billing. Hundreds of cameras and 4G routers in the field, one platform running all of them.



The role



The platform is currently run by a core engineering team. You'll own real parts of the system end to end — write it, ship it, watch it run.



The work is broad: REST APIs and React one day, a camera that won't stream the next, a router dropping its VPN the day after. There's no separate devops or QA team. If that sounds like a mess, it's not for you. If it sounds interesting, keep reading.



Stack



Python 3.12 / FastAPI, React, MariaDB, self-hosted Linux (systemd, nginx), WireGuard, 4G routers, IP cameras over RTSP and ONVIF, WebRTC streaming.



What we need



Strong Python in production — you understand async, blocking calls, connection pools

Solid JavaScript or TypeScript, and you've shipped frontends

Real Linux experience — SSH into a sick server and work out what's wrong

Networking: NAT, VPNs, routing, firewalls. A lot of our debugging lives here

Willingness to work things out when there's no documentation. This matters more than any specific skill on this list



Nice to have (not required — we'll teach you if you are really smart)



RTSP, ONVIF, WebRTC, ffmpeg. CCTV hardware — Hikvision, Dahua, Uniview. 4G/LTE routers. LLM tool-use APIs.



What we're not



No big team, no product manager, no ticket queue. Some weeks are new features, some are firefighting. We want someone smart and curious, not someone who needs a spec handed to them.

Ad A: 

Ad B:

title: Customer Review Specialist (Outbound Calls)
description:
Please fill out the form:



About Goda



We are Goda, a fast-growing DTC brand in the fragrance and skincare space, selling across the US and globally. Our hero products have built a loyal customer base, and we're scaling fast.



We run paid social at high volume, bringing in new customers every day. Our Customer Success team plays a critical role in turning first-time buyers into long-term customers by proactively reaching out, building trust, addressing concerns, and creating positive customer experiences that drive retention.



This is not a traditional customer support role. We don't wait for customers to contact us — we proactively reach out to ensure they succeed with our products and remain engaged with our brand.



The Role



You'll be responsible for making outbound calls to customers across the US market. Your primary goal is to strengthen customer relationships, improve retention, reduce subscription churn, gather feedback, and ensure customers are getting the most value from their experience with Goda.



You'll work closely with our Customer Success and Operations teams, follow established workflows, and maintain detailed records of customer interactions within our systems.



You'll report directly to the Customer Success Manager and be measured against activity, quality, and retention-focused KPIs. We expect you to take ownership, identify customer trends, and surface opportunities that help improve both the customer experience and business performance.



What You'll Be Doing

Outbound Customer Engagement

• Making outbound calls to customers throughout the day to provide support, answer questions, and strengthen customer relationships

• Conducting proactive follow-ups with new customers to ensure a positive experience with their purchase

• Reaching out to subscription customers regarding upcoming renewals, account concerns, and retention opportunities

• Handling customer objections professionally and helping customers find solutions that fit their needs

• Gathering customer feedback and identifying recurring themes, concerns, or opportunities

• Maintaining accurate records of customer interactions, outcomes, and follow-up actions

• Building rapport with customers while representing the brand in a professional and customer-centric manner



Retention & Customer Success

• Identifying customers at risk of cancellation and proactively addressing concerns

• Supporting customer retention initiatives through personalized conversations and relationship-building

• Helping customers understand product benefits, subscription options, and available solutions

• Escalating complex customer concerns through the appropriate internal channels when necessary

• Working closely with leadership to surface customer insights that may improve retention and customer experience



Quality & Accountability

• Meeting daily outbound call targets and productivity expectations

• Maintaining high-quality conversations and customer satisfaction standards

• Following established processes while applying sound judgment when handling unique situations

• Contributing ideas that improve customer experience, call workflows, and team processes

• Taking ownership of customer outcomes rather than simply completing activities



What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

• Prior outbound calling experience in a call center, sales, customer success, retention, or similar phone-based environment

• Comfortable handling high call volumes (40–50 outbound calls per day)

• Excellent spoken English with a neutral or American-accented communication style

• Strong verbal communication skills and the ability to build rapport quickly over the phone

• Resilient, confident, and comfortable handling objections, rejection, and difficult conversations

• Highly organized with strong attention to detail when documenting customer interactions

• Proactive mindset — you identify opportunities and problems before they become larger issues



Nice to Have

• Experience working with subscription-based DTC or e-commerce brands

• Experience with retention, customer success, or subscription management

• Familiarity with CRM, dialer, or customer communication platforms

• Experience supporting US-based customers



Instant No's

• Discomfort with high-volume outbound calling

• Poor verbal communication or difficulty building rapport over the phone

• Lack of ownership when customer issues arise

• Failure to document customer interactions accurately

• Inability to handle rejection or maintain professionalism during challenging conversations

• Waiting to be told what to do instead of proactively taking action



How We Measure Your Performance

• Daily outbound call activity and productivity metrics

• Customer retention and subscription save performance

• Quality assurance scores and call reviews

• Customer satisfaction and feedback

• Accuracy of customer records and follow-up completion

• Consistency in meeting team KPIs and operational standards



Compensation & Benefits

• Competitive salary based on experience

• Fully remote position

• Opportunity to work with a fast-growing DTC brand serving customers across the US

• Clear career growth opportunities within Customer Success and Retention

• Structured training, SOPs, and support systems



???? Our customers are at the center of everything we do. If you're confident on the phone, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and enjoy helping customers succeed while building long-term relationships, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Structural Steel Detailer / Drafter (Shop Drawing Specialist)
description:
Turn structural engineering concepts into high-precision, fabrication-ready steel shop drawings. Designed specifically for the Australian construction sector, this role focuses on the practical mechanics of shop-floor fabrication and site erection—delivering detailed bolt patterns, weld symbols, connection details, and complete Bills of Materials (BOM). This is a technical detailing role tailored for candidates who understand how steel gets cut, drilled, welded, and assembled, rather than general BIM modelers.



Key Responsibilities



Structural Steel Detailing & Shop Drawings

- Generate accurate, fabrication-ready structural steel shop drawings, assembly drawings, and single-part/fitting sheets.

- Detail exact dimensions, member sizes, connection plates, bolt and hole configurations, and standardized welding symbols.

- Create complete Bills of Materials (BOM), bolt lists, material schedules, and cut lists for workshop procurement and fabrication teams.

- Ensure all drawings translate seamlessly from engineering models into constructible components for shop floor fabricators and site riggers.



Modeling & Technical Execution

- Build and refine detailed structural models using Revit Structural and/or Tekla Structures.

- Apply Australian design and fabrication principles to steel frameworks across high-rise commercial buildings and industrial warehouses.

- Perform clash detection and spatial coordination between structural steel, concrete frames, and building services (MEP).



Standards Compliance & Project Coordination

- Ensure all drawings comply strictly with Australian Structural Steel Standards (AS 4100), Steelwork Execution Standards (AS/NZS 5131), and the National Construction Code (NCC).

- Collaborate closely with Australian structural engineers, architects, project managers, and steel fabricators to resolve RFI (Requests for Information) and constructability issues.

- Manage drawing revisions, markups, and document control logs across all project stages.



Requirements & Qualifications



Essential

- Structural Steel Experience: Proven track record in structural steel drafting, detailing, and shop drawing preparation for the Australian construction industry.

- Building Portfolio: Demonstrated experience working on complex high-rise buildings and large-scale industrial warehouses.

- Software Mastery: Strong, hands-on proficiency with Revit Structural.

- Australian Standards: Deep working knowledge of AS 4100 (Steel Structures), AS/NZS 5131, and relevant NCC codes.

- Fabrication Knowledge: Thorough understanding of steel connection logic, shop assembly workflows, weld callouts, and erection sequences.

- Communication: Excellent written and spoken English skills for direct technical collaboration with Australian engineers and project leads.



Highly Desirable (Advantage)

- Tekla Structures Expertise: Hands-on experience with Tekla Structures for structural steel detailing and automated shop drawing extraction.

title: Sales Operations Project Manager
description:
We’re looking for a strong, proactive Sales Operations Project Manager who can lead a sales pod, drive accountability across closers and setters, and maintain seamless communication between Sales, Growth Ops, and Tech Ops.



This is a leadership and coordination role — you are the operational backbone that ensures the pod performs at a high level, SOPs are followed, data is accurate, and every tea
mber stays aligned and supported. If you’re the kind of person who naturally takes ownership, thrives in fast-paced environments, and knows how to communicate with clarity and authority, you’ll excel here.



This is a full-time position, requiring consistent availability from 8am to 4pm Eastern Time, with solid internet, power, and backup.



All applicants must complete DISC and IQ assessments before applying.



Detailed Job Description Breakdown



Pod Leadership & Daily Operations

• Lead and manage the daily workflow of closers and setters to ensure the sales pod operates smoothly.

• Run daily huddles, weekly check-ins, and pipeline reviews with clear agendas and follow-through.

• Manage pod-level projects (e.g., SOP rollouts, funnel changes, tracking fixes) end-to-end, ensuring on-time execution.

• Monitor pod performance, identify bottlenecks early, and escalate issues with solutions—not problems.

• Own the onboarding and offboarding process for new sales staff, including systems access, SOP orientation, and performance expectations.

• Ensure all pod members maintain clean calendars, proper availability, and updated CRM/task workflows.



Quality Assurance, Accountability & Compliance

• Hold closers and setters accountable for submitting accurate EODs, updating dispositions, and following SOPs consistently.

• Conduct quality checks on sales calls, calendar availability, CRM hygiene, and follow-up sequences.

• Audit all sales data regularly (bookings, show rates, sales, payments, renewals) to ensure accuracy before reporting.

• Flag performance gaps early and coach tea
mbers with clarity, empathy, and firmness.

• Ensure all pod documentation, scorecards, and checklists are consistently maintained and up to date.



Cross-Department Coordination

• Work directly with Front-End Tech Ops, Back-End Automation Specialists, and Growth Ops to resolve tech issues, data discrepancies, or workflow breakdowns.

• Communicate updates clearly and quickly across all stakeholders — closers, setters, Growth Ops, SOMs, Tech Ops, and leadership.

• Serve as the bridge for multi-team projects (automation fixes, tracking repairs, new funnels, offer migrations).

• Maintain a strong working relationship with salespeople (who may be impatient or stressed under pressure) while keeping communication tight, professional, and steady.



Reporting & Performance Management

• Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports for leadership, ensuring all numbers are accurate and validated.

• Track KPIs across the full funnel: leads ? setters ? calls ? sales ? renewals.

• Support leadership in evaluating pod performance, identifying improvement plans, and implementing corrective action.

• Ensure the sales pod meets revenue, activity, and quality targets consistently.



Skills & Qualifications

• Project Management experience is mandatory.

(Comfortable managing timelines, action items, dependencies, and follow-through across multiple teams.)

• At least 1–2 years experience in sales operations, sales admin, sales coordination, or a similar leadership/ops role.

• Strong leadership and interpersonal skills — able to hold people accountable with firmness and empathy.

• Excellent verbal and written communication; comfortable leading huddles, giving feedback, and jumping on calls.

• Highly organized, detail-driven, and able to manage multiple moving parts in a fast-paced environment.

• Tech-savvy and comfortable navigating CRM, calendar tools, funnels, spreadsheets, and SOPs.

• Experience working with sales teams (closers/setters) is strongly preferred.

• Solution-oriented, proactive, and able to anticipate problems before they happen.

• Thrives in an environment where communication, speed, and ownership are non-negotiable.



If this sounds like you…



If you love driving clarity, supporting high-performance teams, and being the operational heartbeat of a fast-moving sales pod, we’d love to meet you. This role is perfect for someone who wants to grow into higher-level ops leadership while playing a mission-critical role in our sales organization.



About Sales Possible



At Sales Possible, we partner with mission-driven online coaching companies to build world-class marketing and sales ecosystems. We’re not just a sales team provider — we architect full-funnel systems, optimize performance, and support our clients with cutting-edge automation, AI, and operations infrastructure.



We work with high-growth education brands and expert coaches, helping them scale sustainably while delivering exceptional customer experiences.



We’re a fast-moving, tight-knit team that values ownership, proactive communication, and continuous improvement. If you want to work in an environment obsessed with growth, clarity, and performance — you’ll feel right at home here.

Based in the Philippines with a stable internet connection

Prior experience managing a Shopee store is required

Experience with TikTok Shop is a strong advantage

Strong command of English and Chinese (written and conversational)

Experience in eCommerce is a plus

Familiar with tools such as  Canva, Google Sheets,, or simple video editing.

Detail-oriented, organized, and able to multitask well

Proactive, fast learner, and able to solve problems independently

Able to work in Singapore timezone (GMT+8)



Ideal Candidate

Understands how Shopee works beyond just replying chats

Knows how to improve listings, push campaigns, and support store growth

Has a strong sense of urgency and ownership

Comfortable working in a growing brand where speed and execution matter

The ideal candidate is proactive, detail-oriented, able to multitask, and committed to delivering excellent service while supporting the growth of our merchants and BrickHub's operations.
