title: Admin Support Coordinator
description:
Location: Tabuk City or surrounding Kalinga area, Philippines

Work arrangement: Full-time, work from home initially, transitioning to our future Tabuk City office

Reports to: Philippines Office Manager

About Elite Trades Australia

Elite Trades Australia is a Melbourne-based electrical and plumbing services company delivering residential, commercial, government, maintenance and energy-efficiency projects across Victoria. Our work includes electrical and plumbing services, hot-water and heat-pump installations, property upgrades, maintenance and project delivery.

We coordinate internal field teams and subcontractors through disciplined job-management, scheduling, compliance and documentation systems. Accuracy, ownership and timely escalation are essential to keeping our field operations running effectively.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly organised and detail-focused Field Service Admin Coordinator to support the administration, scheduling, documentation, and operational coordination of jobs for an Australian trades business.

You will manage jobs from the time a purchase order or confirmed booking is received through to job creation, desktop auditing, scheduling, field-worker allocation, subcontractor confirmation, variation processing, billing support, and records maintenance.

This position requires someone who takes ownership of unresolved matters, maintains accurate records, and ensures every job is properly prepared before its scheduled attendance date.

Key Responsibilities

• Same-day job creation. Create ServiceM8 job cards on the day a purchase order or confirmed booking is received; apply the correct status, including “Pending Details” where information is incomplete; and update required stakeholder and scheduling trackers without delay.

• Data integrity. Accurately enter and maintain customer, property, retailer, purchase-order and job information; create or update retailer records; and correct errors or changes immediately.

• Document control. Attach purchase orders, assessment reports, photographs, certificates and supporting evidence to the correct ServiceM8 job before it progresses, keeping ServiceM8 and all contractual trackers aligned.

• Pre-attendance desktop audits. Complete the final desktop review by the business day before attendance, covering clearances, switchboards, access, additional works, modifications, Location Insights and double-storey properties.

• Job readiness and allocation. Confirm standard jobs are booked and ready, assign next-day work across the required platforms, and verify that field workers and subcontractors can access their jobs on mobile devices.

• Escalation and queue ownership. Escalate missing, inaccessible or unassigned jobs—and any unresolved information or documentation—in the operational group and office chat; follow each issue through to resolution; and maintain the Runabout Waiting and Assigned Lists.

• Subcontractor administration. Obtain written confirmation before each subcontracted job, record it in WhatsApp, ServiceM8 and Excel, and enter the job in the Contractor Payment Tracker.

• Invoice readiness. Complete a final documentation check and prepare customer or retailer invoices only when the job record is complete, validating all charges against the purchase order, approved variations and completed works.

• Billing control. Maintain invoicing, accounts-receivable and billing trackers; identify completed but uninvoiced work; progress exceptions to resolution; and assist with invoice follow-up and outstanding-account reporting.

• Bookkeeping records. Maintain approved supplier and subcontractor records, contractor-payment information, supporting documents and basic transaction records, and provide the external bookkeeper with documentation required for reconciliations.

• Variation administration. Prepare draft variation documentation with the required photographs, reports and approvals, then update approved variations in ServiceM8 and the relevant billing records.

• Contractor invoice checks. Check subcontractor invoices against approved jobs, rates and variations, and escalate missing approvals, inconsistent amounts or incomplete evidence to the Philippines Office Manager.

• Compliance support. Organise certificates, photographs, audit evidence and job records, and flag missing, incorrect or inconsistent documentation before the job or invoice progresses.

• File and exception reporting. Maintain organised electronic files using consistent naming conventions and produce daily or weekly reports covering incomplete jobs, uninvoiced work, missing documents and unresolved data issues.

• Operational cover. Provide backup administrative support to the scheduling and customer-service functions during peak periods or staff leave.



Skills and Experience

• Proven experience in administration, job scheduling, operations coordination, or field-service support.

• Strong data-entry, Excel or Google Sheets, and record-management skills.

• Excellent attention to detail and written English.

• Experience with ServiceM8, Runabout, bookkeeping, or similar systems is desirable.

• Ability to manage deadlines, identify errors, escalate issues, and maintain accurate records.

• Reliable computer, stable internet, and availability during Australian business hours.



Performance Expectations

• New jobs must be created and entered on the same day they are received.

• Scheduled jobs must be fully audited and administratively ready by the day before attendance.

• Changes must be updated across all relevant systems immediately.

• Missing information, documents, assignments, or platform-access issues must be escalated promptly.

• No job should progress without the required documentation, checks, and confirmations.

• All operational, subcontractor, variation, billing, and bookkeeping records must remain accurate and current.



How to Apply and Location Details

Applicants should live in Tabuk City or within a practical commuting distance of Tabuk City.

This position will begin as a work-from-home role. The successful applicant must be willing and able to transition to working from our future Tabuk City office when it opens.

Please provide:

1. Your updated résumé.

2. A link to a 2–3-minute recorded video introduction using Loom, Google Drive, or a similar platform. In your video, please explain:

o Your previous administration or operations experience.

o Your experience with job scheduling, data entry, Excel, bookkeeping, or contractor coordination.

o Any experience using ServiceM8 or similar job-management software.

o How you maintain accuracy when managing multiple jobs and deadlines.

o Why you believe you are suitable for this position.

3. A screenshot of your current internet speed.

4. Details of your computer and backup internet or power arrangements.

5. A Photo of your workstation. At least 2 screens required.

6. Your availability to work Australian business hours.

title: Virtual Assistant – Micro-Influencer Research
description:
We are a Canadian handmade craft business looking for one reliable Virtual Assistant to research micro-influencers and content creators who may be a good match for our laser-cut wooden resin-outline kits.



Our wooden outlines are designed to be filled with jewellery resin to create ornaments, suncatchers, magnets, and decorative craft projects.



The main purpose of this position is to build an accurate spreadsheet of relevant micro-influencers for future product gifting, tutorials, reviews, affiliate partnerships, and promotional collaborations.



This role is focused on research and lead generation only. Do not contact influencers unless specifically instructed.



Main responsibilities



• Research micro-influencers and content creators on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Pinterest,
, blogs, and other approved platforms

• Find creators whose content is relevant to resin crafts, jewellery resin, UV resin, epoxy resin, laser-cut crafts, ornament making, suncatchers, craft kits, handmade gifts, or DIY projects

• Identify creators whose audiences are likely to purchase or use resin craft products

• Prioritize creators in Canada and the United States when requested

• Review recent posts to confirm that the creator is active and relevant

• Record all researched creators in a provided spreadsheet

• Locate publicly available business
 addresses or official contact methods

• Record follower counts, average views, engagement indicators, location, platform links, niche, and contact information

• Include links to examples of relevant content

• Note whether the creator mentions gifted collaborations, affiliate programs, product reviews, tutorials, sponsorships, or user-generated content

• Explain briefly why the creator may or may not be suitable

• Identify suspicious engagement, unrelated audiences, inactive accounts, or poor-quality leads

• Avoid duplicate creators

• Mark missing information as “Not Found” or “Unconfirmed” rather than guessing

• Follow the provided research criteria carefully



Creator niches may include



• Resin art

• Jewellery-resin crafts

• UV-resin or epoxy-resin tutorials

• Laser-cut and Glowforge crafts

• Ornament and suncatcher making

• Handmade craft kits

• DIY home décor

• Craft-product demonstrations and reviews

• Small craft businesses

• Handmade gift content



Spreadsheet information may include



• Creator name

• Account or channel name

• Primary platform

• Profile link

• Additional platform links

• Country or location

• Primary craft niche

• Follower or subscriber count

• Average views or engagement indicators

• Date of most recent post

• Public business
 or contact method

• Relevant content links

• Collaboration types mentioned

• Reason the creator is suitable or unsuitable

• Lead result: YES, NO, or REVIEW

• Notes or concerns



Lead classifications



YES – Strong Lead: The creator is active, relevant, has suitable content, and appears to have genuine audience engagement.



NO – Not Suitable: The creator is inactive, irrelevant, has suspicious engagement, or clearly does not match the product.



REVIEW – More Information Needed: The creator may be suitable, but important information could not be confirmed.



Record all creators that are fully researched, including NO and REVIEW results. Accuracy and relevance are more important than producing a large number of leads.



The ideal applicant



• Has experience with influencer research, lead generation, social-media research, or online prospecting

• Understands micro-influencer marketing

• Can distinguish relevant craft creators from general lifestyle accounts

• Can recognize authentic engagement rather than relying only on follower count

• Is comfortable researching TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Pinterest, and other platforms

• Is comfortable using Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel

• Pays close attention to names, links, locations, follower counts, and contact details

• Does not invent
 addresses or missing information

• Can work independently and solve routine research problems

• Follows written instructions and checks available information before asking questions

• Has reliable internet and good written English



Schedule



This is one ongoing part-time position for approximately 10 hours per week, normally completed as about two hours per day, five days per week.



Applicants may have other clients or employment, provided they can consistently complete the assigned work and meet deadlines. Additional hours are not guaranteed.



Selected applicants may be asked to complete a small paid research trial.



Application instructions



Put the word CRAFT at the beginning of your application subject line.



Please answer:



Have you previously researched influencers, creators, or social-media leads?

Which platforms are you most experienced researching?

How would you determine whether a creator is a good match for a resin craft product?

How would you recognize weak or suspicious engagement?

What information would you record in an influencer spreadsheet?

What experience do you have with Google Sheets or Excel?

Can you consistently work approximately two hours per day, five days per week?

Are you willing to complete a paid research trial?



Applications that do not follow the application instructions may not be reviewed.

title: Video Editor (Ads) — For E-Commerce Brand
description:
We're an 8-figure DTC e-commerce brand scaling fast on Meta. We move quickly, test aggressively, and only work with people who can keep up. No corporate politics. No slow feedback loops. Just a sharp, serious team obsessed with one thing: making ads that convert.



We're building something big. We want editors who want to grow with us.



---



The Role



You'll take scripts, raw UGC footage, and creator clips — and turn them into scroll-stopping, high-converting video ads for Meta 
 & Instagram).



This is a performance role, not a content role. Your edits need to sell. Every frame, every cut, every caption has one job: move the viewer from hook to CTA without losing them.



You'll be expected to use AI tools daily to move faster and produce more. If you're not already using tools like Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, VEO, Kling,... - this is not for you

---



## What You'll Do



- Execute **15–20 briefs per week** for Meta

- Turn scripts, UGC, testimonials, and raw footage into polished, direct-response ads

- Produce multiple variations per concept — different hooks, intros, pacing, and CTAs

- Add captions, b-roll, motion graphics, and visual effects that drive retention.

- Use AI tools (voiceovers, avatars, video generation, asset creation) to speed up output and improve quality

- Source supplementary footage and stock when needed.

- Apply feedback fast — iterate based on performance data.

- Deliver in all required Meta formats (9:16, 1:1, 4:5) with clean file organization.



---



## Requirements



- **Minimum 1–2 years editing DTC video ads** (portfolio required)

- **Strong experience with AI tools** — this is non-negotiable. Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, VEO, or similar must already be part of your daily workflow.

- Proven track record editing high-converting ads for Meta 
 & Instagram)

- Deep understanding of hooks, pacing, retention, visual hierarchy, and direct-response structures

- Ability to read a brief and execute precisely — no hand-holding, no back-and-forth

- Proficient in your editing tool of choice (Premiere, CapCut, DaVinci — we don't care, as long as your work is sharp)

title: Marketing Systems Specialist
description:
MARKETING SYSTEMS SPECIALIST

Web systems, funnels, and automation | WordPress + GoHighLevel + Pabbly



Full-time | Remote | Permanent | Semi-flexible schedule





--- ABOUT THE ROLE ---



Built on a vision to empower professionals worldwide into thought leaders, our North-American company fosters a mission-driven culture where every tea
mber feels supported, listened to, and valued, driving trust, growth, and creativity while building a lasting legacy of impact worldwide.  We are looking for one person to own and operate our technical stack: the website, the funnels, and the connected systems for
, automation, and tracking.



This is a dedicated in-house role. There is no agency-style client rotation, no looking for clients, and no handing off projects only to never see them finished. You build the systems, monitor their performance, and improve them. Because you run the stack, you see the long-term results of your work. It is an opportunity to take ownership and level up your skills as our systems evolve.



We are looking for a balanced skill set:



• Technical expertise: You know your way around GoHighLevel and Pabbly to build connected workflows, and tweaking PHP snippets does not slow you down.

• An eye for design: You can design, assemble and build clean, on-brand funnels and pages by yourself when we need to launch fast. This would keep projects moving forward without needing to wait on our design team.

• A curious mindset: You naturally look for ways to streamline operations and automate whatever manual work we did last month.



We are a small team with high standards. People here do what they said they would do, say when something has gone wrong, and are direct in their communications. If you need to be constantly hand-held or chased, this will not be a good fit. 



If you like owning a stack and making it better, we would like to hear from you.





--- WHAT YOU WILL DO --- 



• Build and maintain weekly posts and pages in WordPress using Bricks, including ACF fields and custom PHP snippets.

• Build, manage and optimize funnels and landing pages end-to-end in GoHighLevel and ClickFunnels 2.0, handling everything from layout to tracking.

• Implement structured data and technical SEO across the sites.

• Load and schedule approved
 sequences and campaigns.

• Build, manage, and optimize automations in Zapier, Pabbly, and GoHighLevel.

• Set up and debug tracking in GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta, and LinkedIn.

• Deploy page-level split tests and conversion experiments with accurate tracking.

• Build and maintain weekly reporting dashboards.

• Maintain site health: monitor speed, redirects, broken links, backups, and staging environments.

• Monitor systems daily to catch failures, and either fix them or escalate appropriately.

• Leverage AI tools to accelerate bulk manual work like data migrations and site-wide updates.

• Proactively identify and propose better tools and automation strategies.

• Write standard operating procedures (SOPs) for everything you build.





--- WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR ---



REQUIRED



• Solid WordPress experience with a visual builder (Bricks preferred; Elementor or Oxygen acceptable).

• Comfortable editing PHP snippets.

• GoHighLevel and ClickFunnels 2.0 experience: funnels, workflows, products, contracts, forms, surveys, pipelines, and calendars.

• Proficiency in at least one automation platform: Pabbly, Make, or Zapier.

• Ability to set up and debug GA4 and Google Tag Manager.

• Basic visual competence: you can lay out a professional page, apply brand colors, and place images. A dedicated design team will support you with custom graphics.

• Excellent written English.

• Problem-solving mindset: you diagnose before you escalate, bringing a proposed fix rather than just a problem.

• Independent execution: you are accountable to outcomes, not hours logged.

• Habitual documentation of your work.



BONUS



• Strong graphic design skills.

• Experience with Advanced Custom Fields (ACF) or Rank Math.

• Track record of conversion rate optimization and split testing.

• Proven use of AI tools to accelerate repetitive workflows.

• Technical SEO experience, specifically structured data and schema markup.





--- WHO YOU ARE ---



• Data-driven: You form hypotheses and then test them, and you change your position when the data disagrees.

• High personal standards: You treat your work as a craft and consistently push yourself to deliver excellent results.

• A clear communicator: You write English concisely and proactively on Slack, keeping the team aligned without needing to be chased for updates.

• Eager to grow: You are naturally curious, love leveraging AI to work faster, and actively seek ways to improve existing systems.

• Team-focused: You take ownership of your mistakes, share credit for wins, and approach your work with a mindset of serving the broader team goals.





--- SCHEDULE AND TERMS ---



• Your working hours are highly flexible. The only fixed requirement is a few hours overlapping with morning Pacific Time for two to three live sessions a week, which we will schedule together. 

• Because you manage your own time, proactive daily communication on Slack is required to stay aligned on updates and ongoing discussions.

• This role is focused entirely on one company and one stack. There is no agency churn and no juggling multiple clients.





--- COMPENSATION ---



US$750 per month, paid monthly.





--- HOW TO APPLY ---



Please reply with the following: 



1. Two or three examples of funnels or sites you built end-to-end, noting your specific contribution to each.



2. A short description of a workflow you built or improved without being asked.



3. Details on your GoHighLevel experience (what you have built and which parts of the platform you use most).



--- Note: Applications without work examples will not be reviewed.

I am looking for an experienced Shopify expert who can refine, improve, and elevate my existing website into a more polished, luxury shopping experience.



The goal is to make the site feel as premium, clean, and effortless as the world's leading minimalist fashion brands while maintaining FMB Apparel's unique identity and story.



This project is focused on improvements, optimization, and attention to detail, not creating a completely new website.



About My Brand



FMB Apparel is the primary brand and represents premium streetwear and everyday luxury.



Within FMB Apparel is Day1 Collective, our sister brand dedicated to premium performance apparel. Day1 Collective is a "store within a store"—it shares the same Shopify website but serves a different purpose and customer.



FMB Apparel = Premium streetwear and elevated everyday essentials.

Day1 Collective = Premium performance apparel designed for training, running, the gym, and an active lifestyle.

The navigation should make it easy to move between FMB Apparel and Day1 Collective without confusion.

Overall visual presentation

User experience (UX)

Navigation

Mobile responsiveness

Product pages

Homepage layout

Collection organization

Customer shopping journey

Conversion rate optimization

Website speed

Brand consistency

The integration and presentation of both FMB Apparel and Day1 Collective



I want every page to feel intentional, clean, modern, and premium.

Homepage

Enhance spacing and layout.

Create a stronger luxury feel.

Improve brand storytelling.

Navigation

Improve product descriptions and formatting.

Create a more premium shopping experience.

Overall Design

Improve typography.

Improve spacing and alignment.

Create better visual consistency.

Refine colors and button styles.

Maintain a clean, minimalist aesthetic.

Ensure every page feels cohesive.

Mobile Experience

Review every page on mobile.

Improve responsiveness.

Make shopping easy on all screen sizes.

Improve loading speed where possible.

Design Direction



The website should communicate:



Luxury

Minimalism

Premium quality

Editorial fashion

Modern simplicity

Confidence

Clean architecture

High-end shopping experience



The objective is to create a timeless luxury shopping experience inspired by the best in premium fashion while remaining uniquely FMB Apparel and Day1 Collective.



What I Am NOT Looking For

A complete website rebuild.

A new brand identity.

A new logo.

A new color palette.

A different overall aesthetic.

A generic Shopify template.



Instead, I want someone who can recognize what is already working and elevate it through thoughtful refinements and professional design improvements.

Liquid

title: Client Operations Coordinator
description:
I’m looking for one full-time Client Operations & Communications Manager to keep daily work moving inside a specialist marketing agency serving stand-up comedians, comedy producers, and live comedy venues.



You will coordinate the flow of information between clients, our internal delivery team, third-party contacts, and ClickUp.



This is not a marketing role.



You will not be responsible for marketing strategy, running ads, sales, or growing our business.



Your role is to keep client requests, campaign details, changes, blockers, follow-ups, and internal handoffs organised and moving.



What This Role Is



Information comes into the business through:



-

- WhatsApp

- Intake forms

- Google Drive and Google Docs

- Ticket links

- ClickUp

- Call notes and recordings

- Internal messages



Your job is to turn scattered information into clear action.



You will work with:



Clients, to collect information, answer routine questions, and keep them updated

Internal tea
mbers, to make sure requests reach the right person and delivery work has what it needs

Venues, ticketing contacts, agents, managers, and other third parties when campaign setup requires their involvement



The goal is simple:



No legitimate client request or campaign should stall because information is missing, unclear, scattered, or not followed up.



Main Responsibilities

- Review client
s, messages, forms, and ClickUp activity

- Identify what action needs to be taken

- Create and update campaign and client records in ClickUp

- Track missing campaign details, access, ticket links, budgets, creative, pixels, and approvals

- Make sure client questions and requested changes reach the correct tea
mber

- Draft client replies and, once trained, send routine responses

- Follow up with clients and third-party contacts when information or access is needed

- Track unresolved questions, blockers, and follow-ups

- Help the delivery team find the information it needs

- Keep client and campaign information organised

- Send a short daily update on what moved, what is blocked, and what needs the founder



There will be training.



I still need someone who can learn quickly, take ownership, and work without every task being individually assigned.



What Good Looks Like 

- You keep client requests, changes, and follow-ups moving without waiting for every task to be individually assigned

- You turn scattered or incomplete information into clear next steps

- You ask questions early when something is unclear, bringing the context you have and your best view of what should happen next

- You communicate clearly with clients, internal tea
mbers, and third-party contacts

- You keep ClickUp current so the team can see what changed, what is blocked, and what happens next

- You return to open items and follow through on commitments without needing constant reminders

- You use the available information before going back to a client for something we may already have

- You follow established processes while also pointing out practical ways they could be improved

- The business becomes calmer and easier to run because fewer things need to be chased or personally handled by the founder



What You Need



Excellent written English

Strong attention to detail

Experience in operations, project coordination, client communication, account support, or a similar role

Able to organise messy or incomplete information

Comfortable using Gmail, Google Drive, Google Sheets, WhatsApp, and project-management tools

Comfortable following structured workflows and checklists

Full-time availability

Reliable internet and computer

Able to work independently in a remote environment

Organised, responsive, and comfortable taking ownership



Experience with ClickUp, GoHighLevel, Meta Ads Manager, marketing agencies, ticketing platforms, or US-based clients is helpful but not required.



Being a marketer is not the main requirement.



Being a strong operator is.



This Is Not

A marketing strategist role

A media buying role

A creative role

A sales role

A simple data-entry role

A role focused on marketing our own business

A role where you wait passively for instructions

Working Hours 



Regular Philippine daytime hours are fine.



You will not be required to work a permanent US night shift. The team works asynchronously, but client communication and daily operational work must move reliably.





How to Apply

- Start your application with the word COMEDY

- Use 6 Application Points

- Include a short summary of your most relevant operations or client-coordination experience



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed.



Final Note



Most applicants will not be a fit for this role.



I’m not looking for someone who only waits for tasks.



I’m looking for someone organised, sharp, proactive, and comfortable owning daily operations.



The right person will make the business noticeably clearer and easier to run.

title: RIGHT-HAND ASSISTANT - E-COMMERCE, SOCIAL & AI WORKFLOWS (FULL-TIME, LONG-TERM)
description:
Read this before applying - it will save us both time.



We're not hiring a virtual assistant who works from a task list. We're hiring one person we can hand an OUTCOME to - "keep the Etsy shops selling," "get our music app in front of more families" - who then goes and makes it happen. If you are not proactive, eager to learn and a go-getter please do not apply.



Most of this job is figuring out the how. We'll tell you what needs to be true; we don't always tell you the steps, because we expect you to be proactive and take more off our plate. If that sounds energizing, read on. If it sounds stressful, this genuinely isn't the right role and we'd rather you skip it.



ABOUT US



MMC Media is a small US-based company - the owner plus five people. We run three things:



- A family-safe music streaming app. 5,000+ original songs across 22 genres: pop, rock, country, hip-hop, R&B, electronic, folk, indie and more. Built for parents who want their kids listening to real, current-sounding music without explicit content. It's a mainstream catalog - pop-forward, not a religious app. (We'll tell you the name when we talk.)



- Etsy shops. Digital printables and downloads. Needs attention every single day (about 1 hour).



- Social and content. Several accounts across Pinterest, TikTok, Instagram,
 and YouTube for our blogs.



Honest about our stage: the app is live with real users but early on revenue. You'd be joining to help build something, not to maintain a machine that already runs. Systems are half-built, some things are messy, and you'll often be the first person to do a given task. If you want a large, stable, fully-documented company, you'd be unhappy here. Our other businesses are stable and have more consistent processes and revenue.



WHAT YOU'D OWN



App growth (primary)

- Social content: planning, scheduling and publishing across our accounts - then reading what actually worked and changing the plan because of it.

- Customer support for app users - fast responses, spotting recurring complaints, telling us what you're seeing.

- Launch and campaign support: getting things out the door on time.



Etsy shops (live revenue - this can't slip)

- Customer messages answered every day, without exception.

- Promotions and sales running continuously.

- Listing SEO, publishing new products, watching which listings earn and which don't.

- Keyword research to help us find new listing.

- Using our AI processes to help create new products and listings



AI-driven operations

- Use AI daily - and improve how the work gets done, not just do it faster.

- Bring us new tools and workflows. Part of this job is staying current and telling US what changed.



Reporting

- One brief written report of what you accomplished that day.



Later - not at the start

- This role has the potential to grow into coordinating one or two other people as we grow. That's the direction, not your first-months job, and we won't pretend otherwise. You should have leadership skills as we hope this role will grow into something more.



THE DETAILS



- Full-time, 40 hours/week, long-term.

- Starting at $500/month. Raises here come from results, not from time served - people who deliver have earned multiple increases. If you're asking for more than $500, apply anyway and tell us your number and why. We'd rather talk about it than miss the right person over a starting figure.



- Based in the Philippines, with flexibility to overlap U.S. Mountain Time occasionally for a call.

- We use TeamLogger for time tracking.

- Flexible schedule - days, nights, spread out, weekends. As long as you are consistently working throughout the week and turning in meaningful work.

- PTO after 6 months full-time.

- Paid time to learn. Training happens on the clock.



WHAT WE'RE LIKE TO WORK FOR



- We train people properly and pay for the time it takes.

- We give direct, specific feedback - you'll always know where you stand.

- We're accommodating with real life when you communicate with us. We've carried people through hard stretches. What we can't work with is disappearing.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply through the form here:



Please don't send a separate cover letter - we won't read one. The form is what we read.



A couple of the questions ask you to go look at something before you answer them. Please actually do that part. Those answers matter far more to us than a polished resume, and they're what we read first.



What happens after you apply:



1. We read every application.

2. Shortlisted candidates send us a short recorded intro (about 2 minutes) or hop on a quick call - we want to hear how you explain things, since this role involves calls.

3. Finalists do a paid test project - real work, paid at your rate. That's where we both find out whether this fits.



We know applying takes real time. We'll get back to you either way.

etings (usually 3pm CET)

title: Video Editor (DTC Ads) — 8-Figure E-Commerce Brand
description:
## About Us



We're an 8-figure DTC e-commerce brand scaling fast on Meta. We move quickly, test aggressively, and only work with people who can keep up. No corporate politics. No slow feedback loops. Just a sharp, serious team obsessed with one thing: making ads that convert.



We're building something big. We want editors who want to grow with us.



---



## The Role



You'll take scripts, raw UGC footage, and creator clips — and turn them into scroll-stopping, high-converting video ads for Meta 
 & Instagram).



This is a **performance role**, not a content role. Your edits need to sell. Every frame, every cut, every caption has one job: move the viewer from hook to CTA without losing them.



You'll be expected to use AI tools daily to move faster and produce more. If you're not already using tools like Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, VEO - this is not for you

---



## What You'll Do



- Execute **15–20 briefs per week** for Meta

- Turn scripts, UGC, testimonials, and raw footage into polished, direct-response ads

- Produce multiple variations per concept — different hooks, intros, pacing, and CTAs

- Add captions, b-roll, motion graphics, and visual effects that drive retention.

- Use AI tools (voiceovers, avatars, video generation, asset creation) to speed up output and improve quality

- Source supplementary footage and stock when needed.

- Apply feedback fast — iterate based on performance data.

- Deliver in all required Meta formats (9:16, 1:1, 4:5) with clean file organization.



---



## Requirements



- **Minimum 1–2 years editing DTC video ads** (portfolio required)

- **Strong experience with AI tools** — this is non-negotiable. Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, VEO, or similar must already be part of your daily workflow.

- Proven track record editing high-converting ads for Meta 
 & Instagram)

- Deep understanding of hooks, pacing, retention, visual hierarchy, and direct-response structures

- Ability to read a brief and execute precisely — no hand-holding, no back-and-forth

- Proficient in your editing tool of choice (Premiere, CapCut, DaVinci — we don't care, as long as your work is sharp)

- Fluent written and spoken English

- Fast, responsive, and able to deliver under deadlines

- Reliable internet and remote work setup



---

## Compensation & Schedule



- **Salary:** $1,000/month

- **Schedule:** Full-time

- **Output:** 15–20 briefs per week

- **Growth:** Clear path to senior creative roles with increased pay for editors who deliver consistently

---



## How to Apply



**To be considered, you MUST show us your portfolio. No portfolio, no reply.**



Send us:



1. **Your portfolio or reel** — DTC Meta ads you've personally edited (paid ad work only, no passion projects, no wedding videos, no brand films). This is the #1 thing we look at.

2. A short note telling us which AI tools you currently use in your workflow and how

3. The names of DTC brands you've worked with.



**Start your application with the word "SCALE" at the very top** to prove you read this entire post.



Applications without a portfolio, without "SCALE", or with generic reels will be ignored.



We reply fast to strong applications. If your work is sharp, we'll move you to a paid trial task immediately.



Looking forward to finding our next killer.
